fact: The parliamentary committees' report on the 2026 budget puts the communication-technologies mission, with the ICT development fund, at TND 1,069.327 million against 1,164.823 million in the 2025 finance law, of which TND 197.335 million is state resources.
title: تقرير اللجنتين حول مهمة تكنولوجيات الاتصال - مشروع ميزانية الدولة لسنة 2026
